boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.body: This page stopped working. Nothing you entered has been lost on the server. Reload to try again.

denied.title: You do not have access to this page
denied.body: Your role does not include the permission this page needs. Ask the owner or a manager to grant it.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

handOff.wrongTitle: This page could not be opened
handOff.wrongBody: The server sent the wrong part of the console for this address, and reloading will fetch the same one. Tell support which address you opened.

session.error: We could not check your session
session.errorBody: The connection may be down. Try again.
session.staffInPortal: You are signed in as staff
session.staffInPortalBody: This is the investor portal. Sign out, then sign in with your investor account. Staff use the back office.
session.investorInConsole: You are signed in as an investor
session.investorInConsoleBody: This is the back office, for staff. Your capital, share and statements are in the investor portal.

placeholder.title: This area is built in a later session
placeholder.body: The navigation, permission check and layout work. The screens for {{area}} arrive with their own session.
